typecheck._comment: Ordering matches @dashforge/tw. Both `build` and `typecheck` write declarations into the same dist/: @nx/rollup hard-codes `declaration: true` and `rootDir: projectRoot` with no way to disable it, so it emits a full copy under dist/src plus a one-line dist/index.d.ts re-export wrapper, while tsc emits the real flat tree. Whichever ran LAST decided what the package published, which is why this ordering is explicit: typecheck runs after build, overwrites the wrapper with the real declarations, and drops the copy it just made redundant. See libs/dashforge/tw/project.json for the full analysis.
